title: catalogEntry
description: Builds a tool's catalog entry from the tool and its active loan, read through `LoanRepository.activeForTool`, on each request: for every tool `CatalogReader` reads and for the tool each tool endpoint answers with. The catalog is never stored.

title: projectOutcomeMeasures
description: Reads every loan and tool through `LoanRepository.all` and `ToolRepository.all`, and the `DamageReported` and `ToolRepaired` events through `Outbox.history`, and has the service `measureOutcomes` (TL-LEND-DS02-SV) count the measures, on each run of the report. It stores nothing.

title: activeLoanEntry
description: Builds an active loan's entry from the loan, read through `LoanRepository.activeForTool`, on each request, for the row `ActiveLoansReader` is asked for. The active loans are never stored.

title: waitingForRepairEntry
description: Builds a waiting tool's entry from a tool that needs repair, with its damage report, and whether it has an active loan, read through `LoanRepository.activeForTool`, on each request, for every tool `ToolsWaitingForRepairReader` reads. The entries are never stored.
